Presenter's claim that robust accumulation annuities will compete with ~$25T in mutual funds, ~10x size of guaranteed income market.

Dr. Amanda licensed in 31 states; works only by phone/Zoom from home office.
Spends ~$100-150 per YouTube video promotion; works ~80% of the time (blocked for political/'claim' wording).
All her appointments come from YouTube other than referrals.
YouTube is the second-largest search engine (her statement).
Posting cadence flexed from 1 long+1 short weekly to every two weeks as calendar filled.
Annuities ~ large share of her business; also high-cash-value whole life and some LTC; does Roth conversions with annuities.
Company/announcement: ~$25 trillion in mutual funds vs. accumulation annuities opportunity; AOS launch webinar next day 11am PT.
Company: next week's closing room doubles as all-hands with recognition and new tool announcements.

sales_teachings.detail: YouTube content -> booking link -> intake form -> automated email + warm-up video -> 30-min phone call -> 1-hr Zoom with asset map -> strategy/presentation meeting.
Choose YouTube, podcast, shorts, trade shows, or networking by strengths; she is introverted so uses inbound. Start with 1-minute Shorts if long form intimidating.
Constant CTA avoids confusion; say it in video, description, and website.

sales_teachings.teaching: Brand on the topic, not your name
sales_teachings.detail: 'Retirement Income School'; use SEO and titles matching what people search.
Ask motivating topics (annuities, Roth conversion, whole life, LTC, SS claiming) and specific goals; filters misfit prospects.
Goal is to book next meeting while on the call; open with 'what inspired you to schedule after the videos?'. Phone first creates less resistance than Zoom.
'What is the purpose of this money?', 'What's keeping you up at night?', 'Who else have you worked with and why not a fit?' Record purpose per account in notes.
Front-load it in content; ask 'what do you know about annuities?' and 'have you ever looked at a contract?'; explain variable-annuity fee history and that modern annuities differ.

Ask 'what makes you 100% happy with your advisor?' — nobody is; then ask whether the advisor covered IRMAA, RMDs, widow's penalty, distribution phase; it's fine to keep advisor and add safe-money allocation.
Use Wealth Logix visuals to show FIA/MYGA replacing part of bond allocation.
Automated drip/newsletter; one final 'where do you want to go from here?' message; strong top of funnel reduces need to chase.
'Screw perfection, just get started'; call carriers, partner with mentors, listen to annuity podcasts, pursue designations (RAP, RACP) to match target market.
Roth-conversion/high-premium cases can take ~5 meetings; diversify case mix.
Open problem: a client nearly bought from a seminar after purchasing from her; nurture emails matter.

I always think procrastination is the death of success.
I never meet face to face, only Zoom.

How can you know it's terrible if you don't really know what that tool is, you know, and how you're going to use it.
Your goal of that first call is to book the next meeting.
I could not run my business without annuities genius.
You want to live, eat, breathe, sleep, annuities.
I'm not a person who hides that I'm selling annuities.

synthesis:
AGENT-RECRUITING MESSAGE (COMPANY facts, consistent across V2-V5): (1) 100% street commission, no IMO skim; pay 'reveals value'; commission-only = expendable. (2) Full compensation plan: cap the company at $5M/yr (agent keeps company override; next $5M overrides reinvested into agent business), Agency Builder residual override on up to 7 layers (Rockefeller 1% of 100 people; no marketers - referral-driven; recruit-2-top-producers/year path to 'million-dollar retirement' asset), real (not phantom) stock $1K/$4K/$10K at $1M/$3M/$5M volume (up to $15K/yr). Case study: John Stevenson capping fast and on $50M run rate; Dr. Amanda $5M in <3 months in year 2; Matthew O stock. (3) Platform: 60+ carriers/2,400 products; free CORE back office/Agent IQ/Agent Pay; free join; pre-release letter; JoinAnnuity site; LeadPro (CRM, newsletter, branded site, phone, find-an-agent, Tom Hegna On Demand; one case pays for 3 years; price transcribed '$1.99/mo' but likely $199 [unclear], $299 setup per V5); consumer brand + AI/ChatGPT discovery driving 'order-taking' leads; local-search SEO/Google Business Profile training; performance pathways (Financialize leads, seminars <$3,500, team-selling/WIN); Monday orientation, 7-day training, Wednesday 10am PT Agency Builder call, Thursday Annuity Producers Zoom, Tuesday Closing Room/all-hands. (4) Support/ownership: shareholder agents, founders mentoring, competence+conviction hiring (ex-Google architect, JetBlue CTO). (5) Medicare-agent on-ramp (V2): RAMP script + free IRMAA/tax torpedo tools + 20% bucket commission split so agent earns ~60% while learning, specialists on demand. Inconsistent numbers to reconcile: retirees/day 10,000/11,000/11,200; annuity sales $460B (V3) vs $434B (2024) (V5); agent count ~600 (Oct 2025) vs ~900 (mid 2026); Hegna value $79 vs $97; LeadPro value $552 vs $791.
ANNUITY EDUCATION (sparse): MYGA commissions ~2% vs FIA ~8%; example $150K x 5% = $7,500; total commission ~10% split agent 7%/company 2-3% paid by carrier not client; MYGA maturity (year 3/5/7) as repeat-business trigger; MYGA/FIA as bond replacement (Wealth Logix); IRMAA and SS tax torpedo as Medicare-client hooks; RMD/Roth conversion/widow's penalty as distribution-phase topics; 54% want guaranteed income, <20% have; 89% retirees spend <10% of savings (fear; 'worry less, live longer'); Nassau AOS multi-year FIA with extension, 90% lock and daily crediting (V1, product claim to verify). No rate numbers given beyond commission figures. Auto-caption artifacts flagged [unclear]: 'Irma'=IRMAA, 'Zag Horn', '$1.99', '77%', '$50 billion'. Reusable marketing angles: pay-reveals-value; cap ourselves not you; anti-IMO pre-release; earn-while-you-learn; 'order-taking' via AI/brand; fear-vs-fulfillment mission; Dr. Amanda inbound YouTube system as SEO/content case study.
